name: Locust Pose
description: Belly-down backbend lifting the chest, arms, and legs.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Lie on your belly with your arms by your sides, palms down or up.
Rest your forehead on the floor and keep your legs straight and together.

keyframes.name: Lie on your belly
keyframes.cue: Lie face down with the arms along your sides.

keyframes.name: Locust Pose
keyframes.cue: Lift the chest, arms, and legs off the floor.
